prompt-injection-guard.description: NFKC Unicode canonicalization, PII/credential redaction, and Fail-Closed blocking via promptGuard.ts.

config.name: Prompt Injection and PII Guard
config.description: Sanitize NFKC inputs, redact PII/credentials, and enforce Fail-Closed interception on CallToolRequestSchema.

rule-zero-ephemeral-docker.description: All tests, linters, and audits execute inside non-root ephemeral sinfallas/* Docker containers.

config.name: Rule Zero Ephemeral Non-Root Execution
config.description: Require non-root UID:GID mapping, HOME=/tmp, and Trivy HIGH=0 CRITICAL=0 hardened containers.

postgres-rls-isolation.description: Multi-tenant PostgreSQL 17 isolation with NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.

config.name: PostgreSQL 17 Forced RLS Isolation
config.description: Enforce tenant isolation via SET LOCAL app.current_tenant_id, NOBYPASSRLS role, and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.

worm-hmac-audit-chain.description: Tamper-proof WORM audit log chained with HMAC-SHA256, BIGINT seq_num, and pg_advisory_xact_lock.

config.name: WORM HMAC-SHA256 Audit Chain
config.description: Serialize append-only audit entries with BIGINT seq_num, pg_advisory_xact_lock, and cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 chaining.

vault-aes-256-gcm.description: FIPS 140-3 AES-256-GCM authenticated secret vault encryption with memory zeroization and anti-SSRF guards.

config.name: AES-256-GCM Vault and Anti-SSRF Control
config.description: Encrypt secrets using FIPS 140-3 AES-256-GCM with buffer zeroization and block private-network SSRF targets.

git-closure-human-gate.description: Human-confirmed remote push gate (QA-GIT-GATE-01) forbidding automated git push or npm publish.

config.name: Human-Confirmed Remote Push Gate
config.description: Conclude verified tasks at local git commit and require explicit human approval before remote push or registry publish.

cli-tty-anti-hang-guard.description: Dual CLI/MCP interactive TTY anti-hang guard (QA-CLI-TTY-01) and unmocked container health contract (QA-HEALTH-01).

config.description: Prevent interactive TTY stdio deadlocks and require unmocked container HEALTHCHECK verification.
